subpacket: RMP16-C01 artifact identity, RMP16-C02 startup diagnosis, RMP16-C03 installed journeys (partial), RMP16-C05 uninstall (partial)
owner: coordinator (this session) on a disposable QEMU Windows 11 guest; no author lane used

modelRouting.author: coordinator only; no subagent authored this run
modelRouting.reviewer: independent reviewer agent RMP16Review (fresh context, read-only) reviewed the raw artifacts; verdict recorded in REVIEW.md; it rejected the first draft's save/offline/uninstall/MSI claims until receipts were attached, and those corrections are in this file

scope.in: NSIS and MSI install/uninstall, offline launch with a recorded firewall block, native dialog save/open, in-app slot save and its survival across uninstall/reinstall, one real simulation run, startup instrumentation, WebGL context-loss/fallback/restore, artifact identity on a Windows 11 x64 guest

sourceReconciliation.method: every path in `git ls-files` at the source commit hashed on the host from `git show HEAD:` and on the guest from the working tree; both manifests compared after trimming CRLF
differing: src-tauri/gen/schemas/windows-schema.json — a generated file refreshed by the Windows build. The committed copy is 117,263 B; the guest's regenerated copy is 407,362 B and equals the committed desktop-schema.json/linux-schema.json content. Attribution: build-regenerated generated artifact, not authored source; the committed copy is stale relative to the other generated schemas.
sourceReconciliation.diff: raw/source-manifest-diff.txt (diff is stored as guest→commit; the guest manifest is CRLF so normalize line endings before diffing)

steps: node node_modules/@tauri-apps/cli/tauri.js build --ci (release, MSI + NSIS, updater artifacts)
build.transcriptScope: raw/build-transcript.log is the PowerShell transcript tail (VS/link paths, fixture pubkey, four bundle hashes). It does not enumerate the earlier frontend/WASM steps or a locked toolchain; the build script is attached and the artifact chain is separately anchored by the source manifest, the bundle hashes and the install manifest.

installedVsBuildExeDifference.detail: the NSIS bundler rewrites its own `__TAURI_BUNDLE_TYPE_VAR_UNK` marker to `__TAURI_BUNDLE_TYPE_VAR_NSS` inside the packaged copy; the build-tree copy carries the pre-bundle marker. No other byte differs.

interactiveLaunch.cspBasis: no CSP event appears in the instrumented trace and the smoke records zero page errors; this is the absence of recorded violations, not a separate CSP count

nonInteractiveLaunch.classification: session observation: WebView2 requires an interactive desktop; the same binary starts cleanly on the interactive desktop. No raw file records the session id, so this is stated as an observation, not a proven session-0 attribution.

No edit or export was performed while the fallback was displayed.

limitations: One Windows 11 x64 guest (QEMU), software WebGL only; no hardware GPU, no macOS, no second machine.
The package is unsigned (no code-signing certificate) and its updater artifacts are signed with an ephemeral fixture key; it is not a release candidate.
The build transcript is thin (see build.transcriptScope); the artifact chain is anchored by the source manifest, bundle hashes and install manifests instead.
The historical 2f28c65 blank-WebView reproduction was not attempted because that package and the observation machine are unavailable.
The build script attached as raw/build-script.ps1 had its ephemeral fixture-key password redacted; the fixture private key itself was never copied off the guest.
The context loss was forced with WEBGL_lose_context in software WebGL; a hardware driver reset/GPU process crash was not tested.
The signed-upgrade leg remains unexercised (owner signing/feed authority).
raw/webgl-loss.json is a summary of the CDP steps, not a raw CDP/tunnel transcript; the screenshots corroborate the fallback and restore.
